verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents API Access Tokens that grant access to resources such as CKS clusters and VPCs, plus kubeconfigs generated for a specific cluster. It also offers token exchange for temporary AI Object Storage credentials and bucket policies with principal- and group-based access control, which together give some least-privilege building blocks for storage. However, the evidence never shows per-token permission scopes, roles, or service-account/machine identities that would let a user issue a narrowly scoped credential for an agent. Missing for 10: documented per-token scope/permission selection, service accounts or non-human identities for agents, token expiry/rotation controls, independent corroboration.
